facts.fact: The Nzika Digital ID Wallet was launched in Lilongwe on 16 September 2026 by the National Registration Bureau with partners including UNDP, with more than 22,000 reportedly enrolled by launch, per the Maravi Post column.

Nzika is a digital identity wallet that lets citizens hold digital versions of their National ID and certain civil registration documents, which the column says could make it easier to prove who they are.
The column says World Bank-supported programmes include plans involving digital identity authentication, electronic signatures and electronic know-your-customer services.
facts.system: World Bank-supported digital identity authentication and e-signature plans
